local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local character, humanoid, rootPart
local isInvisible = false
local platform
local heightOffset = 100

local function createPlatform()
    if platform then platform:Destroy() end

    platform = Instance.new("Part")
    platform.Name = "InvisPlatform"
    platform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
    platform.Anchored = true
    platform.CanCollide = true
    platform.Transparency = 0.5
    platform.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
    platform.Parent = Workspace
end

local function removePlatform()
    if platform then
        platform:Destroy()
        platform = nil
    end
end

local function setupCharacter(char)
    character = char
    humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    rootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    isInvisible = false
    removePlatform()
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    setupCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)

local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local oldGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SkyPlatformGui")
if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "SkyPlatformGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 145)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.35, 0)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 29)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
corner.Parent = main

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 95, 130)
stroke.Transparency = 0.55
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Parent = main

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 43)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 28, 42)
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Parent = main

local headerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
headerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
headerCorner.Parent = header

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "SKY PLATFORM"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 238, 255)
title.TextSize = 15
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = header

local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -37, 0, 6)
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 65)
close.Text = "×"
close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
close.TextSize = 22
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.Parent = header

Instance.new("UICorner", close).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22)
status.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 54)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "STATUS  •  DISABLED"
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 175)
status.TextSize = 12
status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
status.Parent = main

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 42)
toggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 87)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(115, 85, 255)
toggle.Text = "ENABLE"
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.TextSize = 14
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.AutoButtonColor = true
toggle.Parent = main

Instance.new("UICorner", toggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local function updateUI()
    if isInvisible then
        status.Text = "STATUS  •  ENABLED"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 160)
        toggle.Text = "DISABLE"
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 75, 90)
    else
        status.Text = "STATUS  •  DISABLED"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 175)
        toggle.Text = "ENABLE"
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(115, 85, 255)
    end
end

local function toggleInvisible()
    isInvisible = not isInvisible

    if isInvisible then
        createPlatform()
    else
        removePlatform()
        if rootPart then
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
        end
    end

    updateUI()
end

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleInvisible)

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isInvisible = false
    removePlatform()
    if rootPart then
        rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
    end
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = main.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
        toggleInvisible()
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if isInvisible and rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
        local currentCFrame = rootPart.CFrame
        rootPart.CFrame = currentCFrame * CFrame.new(0, heightOffset, 0)

        if platform then
            platform.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
        end

        humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, -heightOffset, 0)

        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

        if rootPart then
            rootPart.CFrame = currentCFrame
        end

        humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
    end
end)

--[[

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CorwenHub = {}

function CorwenHub:CreateWindow(hubTitle)
    hubTitle = hubTitle or "CORWEN HUB"

    if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("CorwenHub_UILibrary") then
        CoreGui.CorwenHub_UILibrary:Destroy()
    end

    local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    ScreenGui.Name = "CorwenHub_UILibrary"
    ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

    if syn and syn.protect_gui then
        syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui)
        ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
    else
        ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    -- Main Window Container
    local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
    MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0.25, 0)
    MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
    MainFrame.Active = true
    MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

    local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

    local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    MainStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    MainStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    MainStroke.Parent = MainFrame

    -- Topbar Header
    local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    TopBar.Name = "TopBar"
    TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    TopBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    TopBar.Parent = MainFrame

    local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    TitleLabel.Name = "Title"
    TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TitleLabel.Text = hubTitle
    TitleLabel.RichText = true
    TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TitleLabel.TextSize = 14
    TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    TitleLabel.Parent = TopBar

    local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    CloseBtn.Name = "CloseBtn"
    CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
    CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
    CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
    CloseBtn.Text = "X"
    CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    CloseBtn.TextSize = 14
    CloseBtn.Parent = MainFrame

    local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    CloseCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        ScreenGui:Destroy()
    end)

    -- Draggable Header System
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = MainFrame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
            end)
        end
    end)

    TopBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)

    -- Resizable Corner System
    local ResizeGrip = Instance.new("Frame")
    ResizeGrip.Name = "ResizeGrip"
    ResizeGrip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    ResizeGrip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
    ResizeGrip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ResizeGrip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    ResizeGrip.Parent = MainFrame

    local GripCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    GripCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    GripCorner.Parent = ResizeGrip

    local resizing = false
    local resizeStart, startSize
    ResizeGrip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            resizing = true
            resizeStart = input.Position
            startSize = MainFrame.AbsoluteSize
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if resizing and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - resizeStart
            MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(380, startSize.X + delta.X), 0, math.max(260, startSize.Y + delta.Y))
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            resizing = false
        end
    end)

    -- Floating Toggle Button

    ToggleButton.Name = "CorwenToggle"
    ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
    ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.4, 0)
    ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    ToggleButton.Text = "CH"
    ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    ToggleButton.TextSize = 16
    ToggleButton.Active = true
    ToggleButton.Draggable = true
    ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

    local TogCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    TogCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    TogCorner.Parent = ToggleButton

    local TogStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    TogStroke.Thickness = 2
    TogStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TogStroke.Parent = ToggleButton

    ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible

local Players, RS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("RunService")

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end
local function round(o, r) new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o) end

local frame = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 270), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -105, 0.5, -135),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 18, 36), Active = true, Draggable = true,

round(frame, 14)

new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0),
    Text = "✈ FOLLOW", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15,
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, frame)

local close = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 6), Text = "×",
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60),
}, frame)
round(close, 6)

local list = new("ScrollingFrame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -100), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 36),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 30, 58), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ScrollBarThickness = 3, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
    CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
}, frame)
round(list, 10)
new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)}, list)
new("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 3)}, list)

local function btn(text, x, color)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 12 or 4, 1, -46),
        Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = color,
    }, frame)
    round(b, 10)
    return b
end
local tpBtn = btn("TÉLÉPORTER", 0, Color3.fromRGB(70, 120, 220))
local followBtn = btn("SUIVRE", 0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 90))

local OFF, ON = Color3.fromRGB(52, 44, 82), Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 240)
local selected, conn, entries = nil, nil, {}

local function root(p) return p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
local function hum(p) return p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end

local function states(on)
    local h = hum(me)
    if not h then return end
    for _, s in ipairs({Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll}) do
        h:SetStateEnabled(s, on)
    end
end

local function stop()
    if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
    states(true)
    followBtn.Text, followBtn.BackgroundColor3 = "SUIVRE", Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 90)
end

local function pick(p)
    selected = p
    for pl, b in pairs(entries) do b.BackgroundColor3 = pl == p and ON or OFF end
end

local function rebuild()
    for _, b in pairs(entries) do b:Destroy() end
    entries = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= me then
            local b = new("TextButton", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), Text = p.DisplayName, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
                TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                BackgroundColor3 = p == selected and ON or OFF,
            }, list)
            round(b, 8)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() pick(p) end)
            entries[p] = b
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(rebuild)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
    if p == selected then stop() selected = nil end
    task.defer(rebuild)
end)
rebuild()

tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local a, b = root(me), root(selected)
    if a and b then a.CFrame = b.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 4) end
end)

-- Un clic = suivre, un autre clic = arrêter
followBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if conn then stop() return end
    if not selected or not root(me) then return end

    states(false)
    followBtn.Text, followBtn.BackgroundColor3 = "ARRÊTER", Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)

    conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local mine, theirs, h = root(me), root(selected), hum(me)
        if not mine or not theirs or not h then return end

        -- collé derrière le joueur, immobile, droit, face à lui
        local pos = (theirs.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 4)).Position
        mine.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        mine.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        mine.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(theirs.Position.X, pos.Y, theirs.Position.Z))
        h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
    end)
end)

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() stop() gui:Destroy() end)
me.CharacterAdded:Connect(stop)

freezeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

freezeButton.TextSize = 18
freezeButton.Parent = main

-- Spin button
local spinButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
spinButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 45)
spinButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 112)
spinButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 180, 70)
spinButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
spinButton.Text = "SPIN 200"
spinButton.TextSize = 18
spinButton.Parent = main

local function stopSpin()
    spinning = false
    if spinConnection then
        spinConnection:Disconnect()
        spinConnection = nil
    end

    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root and not frozen then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end

    spinButton.Text = "SPIN 200"
end

local function startSpin()
    if frozen then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    spinning = true
    spinButton.Text = "STOP SPIN"

    spinConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not spinning or frozen or not root.Parent then
            stopSpin()
            return
        end

        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 200, 0)
    end)
end

freezeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not root then return end

    if not frozen then
        stopSpin()

        oldSettings = {
            WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed,
            JumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower,
            JumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight
        }

        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.Anchored = true

        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
        humanoid.JumpPower = 0
        humanoid.JumpHeight = 0

        frozen = true
        freezeButton.Text = "UNFREEZE"
    else
        root.Anchored = false

        humanoid.WalkSpeed = oldSettings.WalkSpeed or 16
        humanoid.JumpPower = oldSettings.JumpPower or 50
        humanoid.JumpHeight = oldSettings.JumpHeight or 7.2

        frozen = false
        freezeButton.Text = "FREEZE"
    end
end)

spinButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if spinning then
        stopSpin()
    else
        startSpin()
    end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    stopSpin()
    frozen = false
    freezeButton.Text = "FREEZE"
end)

local url5 = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NullLuaUndefinedUser/dict/refs/heads/main/dictionary.txt"

local Words5 = {}
local WordSet5 = {}
local WordDictionary5 = {}
local Loaded5 = false
local EnteredWords5 = {}

local Orange5 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 115, 0)
local Purple5 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 30, 85)
local Dark5 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 17, 29)
local LightPurple5 = Color3.fromRGB(95, 55, 120)
local White5 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 220)

local LoadError5 = nil
local LoadSuccessStart5 = nil

local function LoadWords5()
    if Loaded5 then return end

    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local response = request({
            Url = url5,
            Method = "GET"
        })

        if not response or not response.Success or not response.Body then
            error("Unable to download word list")
        end

        for word in response.Body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
            local w = word:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

            if w ~= "" and not WordSet5[w] then
                WordSet5[w] = true
                table.insert(Words5, w)

                local first = w:sub(1, 1)

                if not WordDictionary5[first] then
                    WordDictionary5[first] = {}
                end

                table.insert(WordDictionary5[first], w)
            end
        end

        table.sort(Words5)

        for _, words in pairs(WordDictionary5) do
            table.sort(words)
        end

        Loaded5 = true
    end)

    if not success then
        LoadError5 = tostring(err)
    end
end

task.spawn(LoadWords5)

local function Shuffle5(t)
    for i = #t, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        t[i], t[j] = t[j], t[i]
    end
end

    local inGame = PlayerGui5:FindFirstChild("InGame")

    if not inGame or not inGame:IsA("ScreenGui") or not inGame.Enabled then
        return nil
    end

    local frame = inGame:FindFirstChild("Frame")

    if not frame or not frame.Visible then
        return nil
    end

    return frame
end

local function GetCurrentTurnPlayer5()
    local frame = GetMatchFrame5()
    local typeLabel = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Type")

    if not typeLabel or not typeLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
        return nil
    end

    local text = typeLabel.Text:gsub("<[^>]->", ""):lower()

    for _, candidate in ipairs(Players5:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = candidate.Name:lower()

        if text:find(name, 1, true) then
            return candidate.Name
        end
    end

    for _, candidate in ipairs(Players5:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = candidate.DisplayName:lower()

        if name ~= "" and text:find(name, 1, true) then
            return candidate.Name
        end
    end

    if text:match("your%s+turn") or text:match("you%s+are%s+typing") then
        return Player5.Name
    end

    return nil
end

local function AdjustPrefixSize5()
    local availableWidth = Prefix5.AbsoluteSize.X - 4

    if availableWidth <= 0 then return end

    Prefix5.TextSize = 13

    local textWidth = Prefix5.TextBounds.X

    if textWidth > availableWidth then
        Prefix5.TextSize = math.max(1, 13 * availableWidth / textWidth)
    end
end

local Results5 = {}
local PrefixUpdateToken5 = 0
local MaxDisplay5 = 50
local SuggestionButtons5 = {}

local function Clear5()
    for _, button in ipairs(SuggestionButtons5) do
        button.Parent = nil
    end
end

local function GetSuggestions5(prefix, count)
    if not Loaded5 or prefix == "" then
        return {}
    end

    local source = WordDictionary5[prefix:sub(1, 1)] or Words5
    local possible = {}

    local low = 1
    local high = #source + 1

    while low < high do
        local mid = math.floor((low + high) / 2)

        if source[mid] < prefix then
            low = mid + 1
        else
            high = mid
        end
    end

    for i = low, #source do
        local word = source[i]

        if word:sub(1, #prefix) ~= prefix then
            break
        end

        if not EnteredWords5[word] then
            table.insert(possible, word)
        end
    end

    if SortMode5 == "Shortest" then
        table.sort(possible, function(a, b)
            if #a == #b then
                return a < b
            end

            return #a < #b
        end)

    elseif SortMode5 == "Longest" then
        table.sort(possible, function(a, b)
            if #a == #b then
                return a < b
            end

            return #a > #b
        end)

    elseif SortMode5 == "Random" then
        Shuffle5(possible)
    end

    local results = {}

    for i = 1, math.min(count, #possible) do
        table.insert(results, possible[i])
    end

    return results
end

local function DisplayWords5(words, prefix)

    for i, word in ipairs(words) do

        if not button then

        local matching = word:sub(1, #prefix)

        button:SetAttribute("Word5", word)
        button.LayoutOrder = i
        button.Text = '<font color="#FF7300">' .. matching .. '</font>' .. remaining
        button.TextColor3 = White5
        button.Parent = List5
    end

    for i = #words + 1, #SuggestionButtons5 do
        SuggestionButtons5[i].Parent = nil
    end
end

end

local CurrentWord5 = nil
local PreviousWord5 = ""
local CapturedWord5 = ""
local LastPrefix5 = ""

local LastSeenGameWord5 = ""
local LastCompleteWordInTurn5 = ""
local LongestWordInTurn5 = ""
local LastCapturedVisibleWord5 = ""
local TurnPrompt5 = ""

local AntiIntimidator5 = false

local function ReverseWord5(word)
    return word:reverse()
end

local function DetectIntimidator5()
    for _, obj in ipairs(PlayerGui5:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
            if obj.Text:lower():find("reversed the word be careful!", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function RebuildPrefix5(raw)
    local marker = raw:find("%.%.%.", 1)

    if not marker then
        if raw == "" then
            PrefixFull5 = ""
            PrefixDisplay5 = ""
            PrefixHistory5 = ""
            return ""
        end

        PrefixFull5 = raw
        PrefixDisplay5 = raw
        PrefixHistory5 = raw

        return PrefixFull5
    end

    local suffix = raw:sub(marker + 3)

    if suffix == "" then
        PrefixDisplay5 = PrefixFull5
        return PrefixFull5
    end

    local position = PrefixHistory5:find(suffix, 1, true)

    if position then
        PrefixFull5 = PrefixHistory5:sub(1, position + #suffix - 1)
    else
        local overlap = 0

        for i = 1, math.min(#PrefixFull5, #suffix) do
            if PrefixFull5:sub(-i) == suffix:sub(1, i) then
                overlap = i
            end
        end

        if overlap > 0 then
            PrefixFull5 = PrefixFull5 .. suffix:sub(overlap + 1)
            PrefixHistory5 = PrefixFull5
        end
    end

    PrefixDisplay5 = PrefixFull5

    return PrefixFull5
end

local function DetectPrefix5()
    if not CurrentWord5 or not CurrentWord5.Parent then
        CurrentWord5 = PlayerGui5:FindFirstChild("CurrentWord", true)
    end

    if not CurrentWord5 then return "" end

    local letters = {}

    for _, child in ipairs(CurrentWord5:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
            local label = child:FindFirstChild("Letter")

            if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = label.Text:lower()

                if value ~= "" then
                    table.insert(letters, {
                        text = value,
                        x = child.AbsolutePosition.X
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(letters, function(a, b)
        return a.x < b.x
    end)

    local prefix = ""

    for _, letter in ipairs(letters) do
        prefix = prefix .. letter.text
    end

    return prefix
end

local function GetLiveGameWord5()
    local frame = GetMatchFrame5()
    local container = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("CurrentWord")

    if not container then
        return ""
    end

    local letters = {}

    for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
            local label = child:FindFirstChild("Letter")

            if label and label:IsA("TextLabel")
                and label.TextTransparency < 1 then

                table.insert(letters, {
                    text = label.Text,
                    x = child.AbsolutePosition.X,
                    y = child.AbsolutePosition.Y,
                    order = child.LayoutOrder or 0
                })
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(letters, function(a, b)
        if a.order ~= b.order then
            return a.order < b.order
        end

        if math.abs(a.y - b.y) > 10 then
            return a.y < b.y
        end

        return a.x < b.x
    end)

    local word = ""

    for _, letter in ipairs(letters) do
        word = word .. tostring(letter.text)
    end

    return word:lower():gsub("%s+", "")
end

local function SchedulePrefixSuggestions5(prefix)
    PrefixUpdateToken5 += 1
    local token = PrefixUpdateToken5

    task.delay(0.08, function()
        if token ~= PrefixUpdateToken5 then
            return
        end

        if not Gui5.Parent or Input5.Text ~= "" then
            return
        end

        Results5 = GetSuggestions5(prefix, MaxDisplay5)
        DisplayWords5(Results5, prefix)
    end)
end

local function UpdatePrefix5(prefix)
    if prefix == "" then
        PrefixUpdateToken5 += 1
        Prefix5.Text = "Prefix: -"
        Prefix5.TextColor3 = Orange5

        if Input5.Text == "" then
            Results5 = {}
            Clear5()
        end

        return
    end

    Prefix5.Text = "Prefix: " .. PrefixDisplay5

    task.defer(function()
        if Prefix5.Parent then
            AdjustPrefixSize5()
        end
    end)

    if prefix:find("%.%.%.") or prefix:find("#") then
        PrefixUpdateToken5 += 1
        Prefix5.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0)

        if Input5.Text == "" then
            Results5 = {}
            Clear5()
        end

        return
    end

    Prefix5.TextColor3 = Orange5

    if Input5.Text ~= "" then return end

    SchedulePrefixSuggestions5(prefix)
end

local PrefixConnections5 = {}

local function RefreshPrefix5()
    local rawPrefix = DetectPrefix5()

    if rawPrefix == "" then
        if LastPrefix5 == "" then
            PrefixFull5 = ""
            PrefixDisplay5 = ""
            PrefixHistory5 = ""
        end

        return
    end

    local prefix = RebuildPrefix5(rawPrefix)

    if AntiIntimidator5 then
        prefix = ReverseWord5(PrefixFull5)
        PrefixDisplay5 = prefix
    end

    if prefix ~= LastPrefix5 then
        LastPrefix5 = prefix
        UpdatePrefix5(prefix)
    end
end

local WatchedCurrentWord5 = nil

local function WatchCurrentWord5()
    if not CurrentWord5 or not CurrentWord5.Parent then
        CurrentWord5 = PlayerGui5:FindFirstChild("CurrentWord", true)
    end

    if not CurrentWord5 then return end
    if WatchedCurrentWord5 == CurrentWord5 then return end

    for _, connection in ipairs(PrefixConnections5) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end

    table.clear(PrefixConnections5)

    WatchedCurrentWord5 = CurrentWord5

    local function WatchLetter5(obj)
        if not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then return end

        table.insert(PrefixConnections5,
            obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(RefreshPrefix5)
        )

        local function WatchLabel5(child)
            if child.Name == "Letter" and child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                table.insert(PrefixConnections5,
                    child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(RefreshPrefix5)
                )
                RefreshPrefix5()
            end
        end

        local label = obj:FindFirstChild("Letter")

        if label then
            WatchLabel5(label)
        end

        table.insert(PrefixConnections5,
            obj.ChildAdded:Connect(WatchLabel5)
        )

        table.insert(PrefixConnections5,
            obj.ChildRemoved:Connect(RefreshPrefix5)
        )
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(CurrentWord5:GetChildren()) do

    end

    table.insert(PrefixConnections5,
        CurrentWord5.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            WatchLetter5(child)
            RefreshPrefix5()
        end)
    )

    table.insert(PrefixConnections5,
        CurrentWord5.ChildRemoved:Connect(RefreshPrefix5)
    )

    RefreshPrefix5()
end

local function UpdateCaptured5()
    if not CurrentWord5 or not CurrentWord5.Parent then
        CurrentWord5 = PlayerGui5:FindFirstChild("CurrentWord", true)
    end

    if not CurrentWord5 then return end

    local letters = {}

    for _, child in ipairs(CurrentWord5:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
            local label = child:FindFirstChild("Letter")

            if label and label:IsA("TextLabel")
                and label.TextTransparency < 1 then

                local value = label.Text:lower()

                if value ~= "" then
                    table.insert(letters, {
                        text = value,
                        x = child.AbsolutePosition.X
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(letters, function(a, b)
        return a.x < b.x
    end)

    if #letters == 0 then
        PreviousWord5 = ""
        return
    end

    local visible = ""

    for _, data in ipairs(letters) do
        visible = visible .. data.text
    end

    if PreviousWord5 == "" then
        CapturedWord5 = visible
        PreviousWord5 = visible
        return
    end

    if visible == PreviousWord5 then return end

    if #visible > #PreviousWord5
        and visible:sub(1, #PreviousWord5) == PreviousWord5 then

        CapturedWord5 = visible
        PreviousWord5 = visible
        return
    end

    if #visible < #PreviousWord5 then
        if CapturedWord5:sub(-#visible) == visible then
            PreviousWord5 = visible
            return
        end
    end

    local overlap = 0

    for i = 1, math.min(#CapturedWord5, #visible) do
        if CapturedWord5:sub(-i) == visible:sub(1, i) then
            overlap = i
        end
    end

    if overlap > 0 then
        CapturedWord5 = CapturedWord5 .. visible:sub(overlap + 1)
    else
        CapturedWord5 = visible
    end

    PreviousWord5 = visible
end

local function getClosestEnemy()
    local closestTarget = nil
    local shortestDistance = aimFOV

    for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if targetPlayer ~= player then
            local isEnemy = true
            if player.Team and targetPlayer.Team and player.Team == targetPlayer.Team then
                isEnemy = false
            end

            if isEnemy and targetPlayer.Character and targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then

                    if onScreen then

                        if screenMagnitude < shortestDistance then
                            shortestDistance = screenMagnitude
                            closestTarget = targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart

local function walkToTarget(humanoid, destination)
    local rootPart = humanoid.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return end

    -- Create a path configuration based on agent parameters
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        WaypointSpacing = 4
    })

    -- Compute the path from current position to target
    local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, destination)
    end)

    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()

        for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            -- Handle jump actions if obstacles are present
            if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end

            -- Move to the current waypoint and wait until arrival

            humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
        end
    else
        warn("Path generation failed: ", errorMessage)
    end
end

local function getOriginal(inst)
	local o = originals[inst]

	o = {}
	for _, pair in ipairs(fadeProps) do
		local okIs, is = pcall(inst.IsA, inst, pair[1])

local function applySearch()
	local query = SearchBox.Text:lower()
	local keywords = {}
	for word in string.gmatch(query, "%S+") do
		table.insert(keywords, word)
	end
	
	local anyVisible = false
	for _, child in ipairs(GamepassList:GetChildren()) do
		if child:GetAttribute("IsRow") then
			local title = child:FindFirstChild("Title")
			local sub = child:FindFirstChild("Sub")
			local id = child:GetAttribute("Id")
			
			local textToSearch = ""
			if title then textToSearch = textToSearch .. title.Text:lower() .. " " end
			if sub then textToSearch = textToSearch .. sub.Text:lower() .. " " end
			if id then textToSearch = textToSearch .. tostring(id):lower() end
			
			local match = true
			if #keywords > 0 then
				for _, kw in ipairs(keywords) do
					if not string.find(textToSearch, kw, 1, true) then
						match = false
						break
					end
				end
			end
			
			if match then
				child.Visible = true
				anyVisible = true
				child:SetAttribute("IsMatch", true)
				child.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 75, 45)
				child.LayoutOrder = -1000 + (child:GetAttribute("BaseOrder") or 0)
			else
				child.Visible = false
				child:SetAttribute("IsMatch", false)
				child.BackgroundColor3 = col.panel
				child.LayoutOrder = child:GetAttribute("BaseOrder") or 0
			end
		end
	end
	
	local empty = emptyLabels[GamepassList]
	if empty then
		empty.Visible = not anyVisible
	end
end

SearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(applySearch)

	if child:GetAttribute("IsRow") and SearchBox.Text ~= "" then

	end
end)

local function moveIndicator(instant)
	if not currentTab then
		return

	local btn = tabs[currentTab].button
	local s = MainScale.Scale > 0 and MainScale.Scale or 1
	local x = (btn.AbsolutePosition.X + btn.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 - BottomBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / s
	local pos = UDim2.new(0, x, 1, -2)
	if instant then
		Indicator.Position = pos
	else
		tween(Indicator, 0.4, {Position = pos})
	end
end

local function setTab(index, instant)
	if index == currentTab then
		return
	end
	local prev = currentTab
	local dir = (prev and index < prev) and -1 or 1
	currentTab = index

	for i, tab in ipairs(tabs) do
		local goal = i == index and navActive or idle
		if instant then
			for k, v in pairs(goal) do
				tab.button[k] = v
			end
		else
			tween(tab.button, 0.2, goal)
		end
	end
	moveIndicator(instant)

	if prev then
		local old = tabs[prev].screen
		if instant then
			old.Visible = false
		else
			fade(old, 0, 0.15)
			tween(old, 0.25, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.06 * dir, 0)})
			task.delay(0.25, function()
				if tabs[currentTab].screen ~= old then
					old.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local screen = tabs[index].screen
	screen.Visible = true
	if instant then
		screen.Position = UDim2.new()
		fade(screen, 1, 0)
	else
		screen.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06 * dir, 0)
		fade(screen, 0, 0)
		tween(screen, 0.4, {Position = UDim2.new()})
		fade(screen, 1, 0.3)
	end
end

	local rampLen = #ramp

	local cols, rows, offX, offY = 0, 0, 0, 0
	local glow = {}
	local bufs = {{}, {}, {}}
	local lines = {{}, {}, {}}

	function ascii.rebuild(area, inner)
		cols = math.max(1, math.floor(area.X / cw))
		rows = math.max(1, math.floor(area.Y / ch))
		offX = (area.X - cols * cw) / 2
		offY = (area.Y - rows * ch) / 2

		for _, l in ipairs(labels) do
			l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(offX, offY)
			l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cols * cw + 4, rows * ch + 4)
		end

		local cx, cy = area.X / 2, area.Y / 2
		local hw, hh = inner.X / 2, inner.Y / 2
		local pad = asciiCfg.padding
		table.clear(glow)
		for y = 0, rows - 1 do
			local qy = math.max(math.abs(offY + (y + 0.5) * ch - cy) - hh, 0)
			for x = 0, cols - 1 do
				local qx = math.max(math.abs(offX + (x + 0.5) * cw - cx) - hw, 0)
				local i = y * cols + x + 1
				if qx == 0 and qy == 0 then
					glow[i] = -1
				else
					local g = math.clamp(1 - math.sqrt(qx * qx + qy * qy) / pad, 0, 1)
					glow[i] = g * g * (3 - 2 * g)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(bufs) do
			table.clear(b)
		end
	end

	local noise, sin, cos, sqrt, exp, floor = math.noise, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.exp, math.floor
	local min1, min2, min3 = layers[1].min, layers[2].min, layers[3].min
	local aspect = ch / cw

	function ascii.render(t, alpha, mx, my)
		local mcx, mcy
		if mx then
			mcx, mcy = (mx - offX) / cw, (my - offY) / ch
		end
		local b1, b2, b3 = bufs[1], bufs[2], bufs[3]
		local l1, l2, l3 = lines[1], lines[2], lines[3]

		for y = 0, rows - 1 do
			local base = y * cols
			local ny = y * 0.11 - t * 0.35
			local wy = cos(y * 0.21 - t * 0.7)
			for x = 0, cols - 1 do
				local g = glow[base + x + 1]
				local c1, c2, c3 = " ", " ", " "
				if g > 0 then
					local v = 0.45 + noise(x * 0.055, ny, t * 0.12) * 1.3 + sin(x * 0.12 + t * 1.1) * wy * 0.18
					if mcx then
						local dx, dy = x - mcx, (y - mcy) * aspect
						local d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
						v += sin(d * 0.45 - t * 7) * exp(-d * 0.09) * 0.45
					end
					v *= g * alpha
					if v >= min1 then
						local idx = math.clamp(floor(v * rampLen) + 1, 2, rampLen)
						local glyph = ramp[idx]
						if v >= min3 then
							c3 = glyph
						elseif v >= min2 then
							c2 = glyph
						else
							c1 = glyph
						end
					end
				end
				b1[x + 1], b2[x + 1], b3[x + 1] = c1, c2, c3
			end
			l1[y + 1] = table.concat(b1, "", 1, cols)
			l2[y + 1] = table.concat(b2, "", 1, cols)
			l3[y + 1] = table.concat(b3, "", 1, cols)
		end

		labels[1].Text = table.concat(l1, "\n", 1, rows)
		labels[2].Text = table.concat(l2, "\n", 1, rows)
		labels[3].Text = table.concat(l3, "\n", 1, rows)

		for i, layer in ipairs(layers) do
			labels[i].TextTransparency = 1 - (1 - layer.transparency) * alpha
		end
	end
end

local asciiAlpha = Instance.new("NumberValue")

do
	local acc, lastArea = 0, nil
	local start = os.clock()

	bind(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
		AsciiHolder.Position = Main.Position
		if not asciiCfg.enabled then
			return
		end

		local alpha = asciiAlpha.Value
		if alpha <= 0.001 then
			return
		end

		acc += dt
		if acc < 1 / asciiCfg.fps then
			return
		end
		acc = 0

		local s = MainScale.Scale > 0 and MainScale.Scale or 1
		local abs = Main.AbsoluteSize
		local inner = Vector2.new(math.floor(abs.X / s + 0.5), math.floor(abs.Y / s + 0.5))
		local area = inner + Vector2.new(asciiCfg.padding * 2, asciiCfg.padding * 2)
		if area ~= lastArea then
			lastArea = area
			AsciiHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(area.X, area.Y)
			ascii.rebuild(area, inner)
		end

		local mx, my
		if asciiCfg.mouse then
			local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - AsciiHolder.AbsolutePosition
			if m.X >= 0 and m.Y >= 0 and m.X <= area.X and m.Y <= area.Y then
				mx, my = m.X, m.Y
			end
		end

		ascii.render(os.clock() - start, alpha, mx, my)
	end)
end

local infoCache = {}
local function getInfo(kind, id)
	local key = kind .. ":" .. tostring(id)
	if infoCache[key] ~= nil then
		return infoCache[key]
	end
	local info = false
	if infoTypes[kind] and tonumber(id) then
		local ok, res = pcall(function()
			return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(tonumber(id), infoTypes[kind])
		end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then
			info = res
		end
	end
	infoCache[key] = info
	return info
end

local function sendToFaker(id)
	InpBox.Text = tostring(id)
	setTabByName("Faker")
	toast("ID loaded: " .. tostring(id))
end

local fire = {
	Product = function(id)
		MarketplaceService:SignalPromptProductPurchaseFinished(LocalPlayer.UserId, id, true)
	end,
	Gamepass = function(id)
		MarketplaceService:SignalPromptGamePassPurchaseFinished(LocalPlayer, id, true)
	end,
	Asset = function(id)
		MarketplaceService:SignalPromptPurchaseFinished(LocalPlayer, id, true)
	end,
	Bundle = function(id)
		MarketplaceService:SignalPromptBundlePurchaseFinished(LocalPlayer, id, true)
	end,
}

local function detectKind(id)
	local known = knownKinds[tostring(id)]
	if known and fire[known] then
		return known
	end
	for _, kind in ipairs({"Product", "Gamepass", "Asset"}) do
		if getInfo(kind, id) then
			knownKinds[tostring(id)] = kind
			return kind
		end
	end
	return "Product"
end

local function fakePurchase(id)
	local kind = detectKind(id)
	fire[kind](id)
	return kind
end

local function stopAutoFake(silent)
	if not autoFake then
		return
	end
	autoFake = false
	setAutoVisual()
	if not silent and not destroyed then
		toast("Auto fake stopped", col.yellow)
	end
end

local function startAutoFake()
	if autoFake then
		stopAutoFake()
		return
	end
	local id = tonumber((InpBox.Text:gsub("%s", "")):match("^%d+$"))
	if not id then
		shake(IdInput, idInputPos)
		toast("Enter a valid ID", col.red)
		return
	end
	autoFake = true
	setAutoVisual()
	toast(("Auto faking %d every 0.1s"):format(id), col.green)

	task.spawn(function()
		local resolving = {}
		while autoFake and not destroyed do
			local cur = tonumber((InpBox.Text:gsub("%s", "")):match("^%d+$"))
			if not cur then
				stopAutoFake(true)
				break
			end

			local kind = knownKinds[tostring(cur)]
			if kind and fire[kind] then
				if not pcall(fire[kind], cur) then
					stopAutoFake(true)
					break
				end
			elseif not resolving[cur] then
				resolving[cur] = true
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok, k = pcall(detectKind, cur)
					if ok then
						knownKinds[tostring(cur)] = k
					end
					resolving[cur] = nil
				end)
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

local httpRequest = (typeof(request) == "function" and request)
	or (typeof(http_request) == "function" and http_request)
	or (syn and syn.request)
	or (http and http.request)
	or (fluxus and fluxus.request)

local function getJson(url)
	local body
	if httpRequest then
		local ok, res = pcall(httpRequest, {Url = url, Method = "GET"})
		if ok and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode == 200 or (res.StatusCode == nil and res.Success)) then
			body = res.Body
		end
	end
	if not body then
		local ok, res = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(url)
		end)
		if ok then
			body = res
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, body)
	return ok and data or nil
end

local function nonEmpty(s)
	return type(s) == "string" and s ~= "" and s or nil
end

local passSources = {
	{
		hosts = {"apis.roblox.com", "apis.roproxy.com"},
		url = function(host, universeId, cursor)
			local page = cursor and "&pageToken=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(cursor) or ""
			return ("https://%s/game-passes/v1/universes/%d/game-passes?passView=Full&pageSize=100%s"):format(host, universeId, page)
		end,
		parse = function(d)
			if type(d) ~= "table" or type(d.gamePasses) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end
			local out = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(d.gamePasses) do
				local priceInfo = type(p.priceInformation) == "table" and p.priceInformation or {}
				table.insert(out, {
					id = p.id or p.gamePassId,
					name = p.displayName or p.name,
					price = p.price or priceInfo.defaultPriceInRobux or priceInfo.price,
				})
			end
			return out, nonEmpty(d.nextPageToken)
		end,
	},
	{
		hosts = {"games.roblox.com", "games.roproxy.com"},
		url = function(host, universeId, cursor)
			local page = cursor and "&cursor=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(cursor) or ""
			return ("https://%s/v1/games/%d/game-passes?limit=100&sortOrder=Asc%s"):format(host, universeId, page)
		end,
		parse = function(d)
			if type(d) ~= "table" or type(d.data) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end
			local out = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(d.data) do
				table.insert(out, {id = p.id, name = p.displayName or p.name, price = p.price})
			end
			return out, nonEmpty(d.nextPageCursor)
		end,
	},
}

local function fetchGamepasses(universeId)
	for _, source in ipairs(passSources) do
		for _, host in ipairs(source.hosts) do
			local all, cursor = source.parse(getJson(source.url(host, universeId)))
			if all then
				local pages = 1
				while cursor and pages < 25 do
					local more, nextCursor = source.parse(getJson(source.url(host, universeId, cursor)))
					if not more then
						break
					end
					for _, p in ipairs(more) do
						table.insert(all, p)
					end
					cursor, pages = nextCursor, pages + 1
				end
				return all
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function fetchProducts()
	local ok, pages = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:GetDeveloperProductsAsync()
	end)
	if not ok or not pages then
		return nil
	end
	local out = {}
	for _ = 1, 50 do
		local okPage, page = pcall(function()
			return pages:GetCurrentPage()
		end)
		if not okPage then
			break
		end
		for _, item in ipairs(page) do
			local iconId = item.IconImageAssetId
			table.insert(out, {
				id = item.ProductId or item.DeveloperProductId,
				name = item.Name or item.DisplayName,
				price = item.PriceInRobux,
				icon = iconId and iconId ~= 0 and "rbxassetid://" .. iconId or nil,
			})
		end
		if pages.IsFinished or not pcall(function() pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync() end) then
			break
		end
	end
	return out
end

local scanning = false
scanProducts = function()
	if scanning or destroyed then
		return
	end
	scanning = true
	clearList(GamepassList)
	local empty = emptyLabels[GamepassList]
	empty.Text = "Scanning..."

	task.spawn(function()
		local passes, products
		task.spawn(function()
			passes = fetchGamepasses(game.GameId) or false
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			products = fetchProducts() or false
		end)
		while (passes == nil or products == nil) and not destroyed do
			task.wait()
		end
		if destroyed then
			return
		end

		local function byPrice(a, b)
			return (a.price or math.huge) < (b.price or math.huge)
		end

		local order = 0
		for _, group in ipairs({{passes, "Gamepass"}, {products, "Product"}}) do
			local items, kind = group[1], group[2]
			if items then
				table.sort(items, byPrice)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					if item.id then
						order += 1
						addPass({id = item.id, name = item.name, price = item.price, icon = item.icon, kind = kind, order = order})
					end
				end
			end
		end

		empty.Text = "Nothing found for this game."
		local nPasses, nProducts = passes and #passes or 0, products and #products or 0
		if not passes and not products then
			toast("Couldn't fetch passes or products", col.red)
		elseif not passes then
			toast(("Found %d products, gamepass fetch failed"):format(nProducts), col.yellow)
		elseif not products then
			toast(("Found %d gamepasses, product fetch failed"):format(nPasses), col.yellow)
		else
			toast(("Found %d gamepasses, %d products"):format(nPasses, nProducts), col.green)
		end
		scanning = false
		applySearch()
	end)
end

local logLimit = 100
local logOrder = 0
local logRows = {}
local lastPrompt = {}
local pendingRows = {}

local function iconFor(kind, id, info)
	local n = tonumber(id)
	if n and kind == "Gamepass" then
		return ("rbxthumb://type=GamePass&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(n)
	elseif n and kind == "Asset" then
		return ("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(n)
	elseif n and kind == "Bundle" then
		return ("rbxthumb://type=BundleThumbnail&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(n)
	end
	local iconId = info and info.IconImageAssetId
	if iconId and iconId ~= 0 then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. iconId
	end
end

local function addLog(data)
	logOrder -= 1
	knownKinds[tostring(data.id)] = data.kind
	local sub = {data.kind}
	if data.price then
		table.insert(sub, "R$" .. commas(data.price))
	end
	table.insert(sub, os.date("%H:%M:%S"))

	local row = makeRow(ProductLogger, {
		id = data.id,
		title = data.name or tostring(data.id),
		sub = table.concat(sub, "  •  "),
		icon = data.icon,
		order = logOrder,
		onClick = function()
			sendToFaker(data.id)
		end,
	}, img.copy, function()
		copyId(data.id)
	end)

	table.insert(logRows, row)
	if #logRows > logLimit then
		table.remove(logRows, 1):Destroy()
	end
	return row
end

local function logPrompt(kind, id)
	if destroyed or id == nil then
		return
	end
	local key = kind .. ":" .. tostring(id)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPrompt[key] and now - lastPrompt[key] < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	lastPrompt[key] = now

	task.spawn(function()
		local info = getInfo(kind, id)
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		pendingRows[key] = addLog({
			id = id,
			kind = kind,
			name = info and (info.Name or info.DisplayName),
			price = info and (info.PriceInRobux or info.Price),
			icon = iconFor(kind, id, info),
		})
		if not ProductLogger.Visible then
			toast(("Logged %s %s"):format(kind:lower(), tostring(id)))
		end
	end)
end

local function markFinished(kind, id, purchased)
	local key = kind .. ":" .. tostring(id)
	local row = pendingRows[key]
	pendingRows[key] = nil
	local sub = row and row.Parent and row:FindFirstChild("Sub")
	if sub then
		sub.Text ..= "  •  " .. (purchased and "Bought" or "Closed")
		tween(sub, 0.3, {TextColor3 = purchased and col.green or col.dim})
	end
end

local function firstId(...)
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local v = select(i, ...)
		if type(v) == "number" or (type(v) == "string" and v ~= "") then
			return v
		end
	end
end

local function lastBool(...)
	for i = select("#", ...), 1, -1 do
		local v = select(i, ...)
		if type(v) == "boolean" then
			return v
		end
	end
	return false
end

local promptKinds = {
	ProductPurchase = "Product",
	GamePassPurchase = "Gamepass",
	Purchase = "Asset",
	BundlePurchase = "Bundle",
	SubscriptionPurchase = "Subscription",
}

local hooked = 0
for suffix, kind in pairs(promptKinds) do
	local ok = pcall(function()
		bind(MarketplaceService["Prompt" .. suffix .. "Requested"], function(_, ...)
			logPrompt(kind, firstId(...))
		end)
	end)
	if ok then
		hooked += 1
	end
	pcall(function()
		bind(MarketplaceService["Prompt" .. suffix .. "Finished"], function(_, ...)
			markFinished(kind, firstId(...), lastBool(...))
		end)
	end)
end

if hooked == 0 and typeof(hookmetamethod) == "function" and typeof(getnamecallmethod) == "function" then
	local old
	local function handler(self, ...)
		local method = getnamecallmethod()
		if not destroyed and self == MarketplaceService and method:sub(1, 6) == "Prompt" then
			local kind = promptKinds[method:sub(7)]
			if kind then
				task.spawn(logPrompt, kind, select(2, ...))
			end
		end
		return old(self, ...)
	end
	pcall(function()
		old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", typeof(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure(handler) or handler)
	end)
end

local function getFromHosts(path, hosts)
	for _, host in ipairs(hosts) do
		local d = getJson("https://" .. host .. path)
		if type(d) == "table" then
			return d
		end
	end
end

local universeCache = {}
local function getUniverseId(placeId)
	if placeId == game.PlaceId and game.GameId ~= 0 then
		return game.GameId
	end
	if universeCache[placeId] then
		return universeCache[placeId]
	end
	local d = getFromHosts("/universes/v1/places/" .. placeId .. "/universe", {"apis.roblox.com", "apis.roproxy.com"})
	local id = d and tonumber(d.universeId)
	universeCache[placeId] = id
	return id
end

local function getGameStats(universeIds)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #universeIds, 50 do
		local chunk = table.concat(universeIds, ",", i, math.min(i + 49, #universeIds))
		local d = getFromHosts("/v1/games?universeIds=" .. chunk, {"games.roblox.com", "games.roproxy.com"})
		if d and type(d.data) == "table" then
			for _, g in ipairs(d.data) do
				out[tonumber(g.id)] = g
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

local loadingSupported = false
loadSupported = function()
	if loadingSupported or destroyed then
		return
	end
	loadingSupported = true

	local empty = emptyLabels[SupportedContainer]
	clearList(SupportedContainer)
	empty.Text = "Loading supported games..."

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, list = pcall(function()
			return loadstring(game:HttpGet(supportedUrl))()
		end)
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		if not ok or type(list) ~= "table" then
			warn("[Product Faker] supported list failed: " .. tostring(list))
			list = {}
		end

		do
			local present = {}
			for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
				local pid = type(entry) == "table" and (entry.PlaceId or entry[1]) or entry
				if tonumber(pid) then
					present[tonumber(pid)] = true
				end
			end
			for _, entry in ipairs(localSupportedGames) do
				if not present[entry.PlaceId] then
					table.insert(list, entry)
					present[entry.PlaceId] = true
				end
			end
		end

		clearList(SupportedContainer)
		empty.Text = "No supported games listed."

		local entries = {}
		local supportedHere = false

		for i, entry in ipairs(list) do
			local placeId, name, warning = entry, nil, nil
			if type(entry) == "table" then
				placeId, name, warning = entry.PlaceId or entry[1], entry.Name, entry.Warning
			end
			placeId = tonumber(placeId)

			if placeId then
				local here = placeId == game.PlaceId
				supportedHere = supportedHere or here

				local initialSub = here and "You're in this game  •  " or ""
				if warning then
					initialSub = initialSub .. warning .. "  •  "
				end
				initialSub = initialSub .. "Loading players..."

				local row = makeRow(SupportedContainer, {
					title = name or "Place " .. placeId,
					sub = initialSub,
					icon = ("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(placeId),
					order = here and -1 or i,
				}, img.join, function()
					if here then
						toast("You're already in this game", col.yellow)
					else
						toast("Teleporting...")
						pcall(TeleportService.Teleport, TeleportService, placeId, LocalPlayer)
					end
				end)

				if warning then
					row.Sub.TextColor3 = col.yellow
				elseif here then
					row.Sub.TextColor3 = col.green
				end
				
				table.insert(entries, {row = row, placeId = placeId, here = here, named = name ~= nil, warning = warning})
			end
		end

		if supportedHere then
			toast("This game is supported", col.green)
		end

		local pending = #entries
		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			task.spawn(function()
				local okId, id = pcall(getUniverseId, e.placeId)
				e.universeId = okId and id or nil
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		while pending > 0 and not destroyed do
			task.wait()
		end
		if destroyed then
			return
		end

		local ids, seen = {}, {}
		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			if e.universeId and not seen[e.universeId] then
				seen[e.universeId] = true
				table.insert(ids, e.universeId)
			end
		end

		local stats = #ids > 0 and getGameStats(ids) or {}
		if destroyed then
			return
		end

		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			local row = e.row
			if row.Parent then
				local g = e.universeId and stats[e.universeId]
				local prefix = e.here and "You're in this game  •  " or ""
				local warningPrefix = e.warning and (e.warning .. "  •  ") or ""
				
				if g and g.playing then
					row.Sub.Text = prefix .. warningPrefix .. commas(g.playing) .. " playing"
				else
					row.Sub.Text = prefix .. warningPrefix .. "Players unavailable"
				end
				
				if e.warning then
					row.Sub.TextColor3 = col.yellow
				end
				
				if not e.named and g and g.name then
					row.Title.Text = g.name
				end
			end
		end

		loadingSupported = false
	end)
end

scripts.code:
local function solve(clues)
    local known = {}
    local changed = true
    while changed do
        changed = false
        local residuals, byTile = {}, {}
        for _, clue in ipairs(clues) do
            local need, remaining = clue.count, {}
            for _, id in ipairs(clue.ids) do
                if known[id] == nil then
                    remaining[id] = true
                else
                    need -= known[id]
                end
            end
            local count = 0
            for _ in pairs(remaining) do count += 1 end
            if need < 0 or need > count then return {}, false end
            if count > 0 and (need == 0 or need == count) then
                local value = if need == 0 then 0 else 1
                for id in pairs(remaining) do known[id] = value end
                changed = true
            elseif count > 0 then
                local residual = {ids = remaining, count = count, need = need}
                table.insert(residuals, residual)
                for id in pairs(remaining) do
                    byTile[id] = byTile[id] or {}
                    table.insert(byTile[id], residual)
                end
            end
        end

        if not changed then
            for _, small in ipairs(residuals) do
                local first = next(small.ids)
                for _, large in ipairs(byTile[first]) do
                    if small == large or small.count > large.count then continue end
                    local subset = true
                    for id in pairs(small.ids) do
                        if not large.ids[id] then
                            subset = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not subset then continue end
                    local need = large.need - small.need
                    local extra = large.count - small.count
                    if need < 0 or need > extra then return {}, false end
                    if extra > 0 and (need == 0 or need == extra) then
                        for id in pairs(large.ids) do
                            if not small.ids[id] then known[id] = if need == 0 then 0 else 1 end
                        end
                        changed = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if changed then break end
            end
        end
    end

    local frontier = {}
    for _, clue in ipairs(clues) do
        local edge = {ids = {}, need = clue.count, used = 0, left = 0}
        for _, id in ipairs(clue.ids) do
            if known[id] == nil then
                table.insert(edge.ids, id)
                frontier[id] = frontier[id] or {}
                table.insert(frontier[id], edge)
            else
                edge.need -= known[id]
            end
        end
        edge.left = #edge.ids
    end

    local visited, budget = {}, 180000
    local stopAt = os.clock() + 0.035
    for first in pairs(frontier) do
        if visited[first] then continue end
        local ids, seenEdges = {first}, {}
        visited[first] = true
        local cursor = 1
        while cursor <= #ids do
            for _, edge in ipairs(frontier[ids[cursor]]) do
                if seenEdges[edge] then continue end
                seenEdges[edge] = true
                for _, id in ipairs(edge.ids) do
                    if not visited[id] then
                        visited[id] = true
                        table.insert(ids, id)
                    end
                end
            end
            cursor += 1
        end
        if #ids > 64 or budget <= 0 or os.clock() >= stopAt then continue end

        local linked, used = {}, {}
        local ordered = {}
        for _ = 1, #ids do
            local best, bestScore
            for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
                if used[id] then continue end
                local score = (linked[id] or 0) * 100 + #frontier[id]
                if not bestScore or score > bestScore then
                    best, bestScore = id, score
                end
            end
            used[best] = true
            table.insert(ordered, best)
            for _, edge in ipairs(frontier[best]) do
                for _, id in ipairs(edge.ids) do
                    if not used[id] then linked[id] = (linked[id] or 0) + 1 end
                end
            end
        end
        ids = ordered
        local assignments, mineCounts, solutions = {}, {}, 0
        local componentBudget = math.min(70000, budget)
        local function enumerate(index)
            if componentBudget <= 0 or (componentBudget % 256 == 0 and os.clock() >= stopAt) then return false end
            budget -= 1
            componentBudget -= 1
            if index > #ids then
                solutions += 1
                for i, value in ipairs(assignments) do
                    mineCounts[i] = (mineCounts[i] or 0) + value
                end
                return true
            end
            local adjacent = frontier[ids[index]]
            for value = 0, 1 do
                local valid = true
                for _, edge in ipairs(adjacent) do
                    edge.left -= 1
                    edge.used += value
                    if edge.used > edge.need or edge.used + edge.left < edge.need then valid = false end
                end
                local complete = true
                if valid then
                    assignments[index] = value
                    complete = enumerate(index + 1)
                end
                for _, edge in ipairs(adjacent) do
                    edge.left += 1
                    edge.used -= value
                end
                if not complete then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        if not enumerate(1) then continue end
        if solutions == 0 then return {}, false end
        for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
            known[id] = (mineCounts[i] or 0) / solutions
        end
    end
    return known, true
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

if resumedSettings then

        if resumedSettings[key] ~= nil then settings[key] = resumedSettings[key] end

end
state.settings = settings
local colors = {
    safe = Color3.fromRGB(64, 236, 117),
    bomb = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 85),
    half = Color3.fromRGB(255, 208, 66),
    suggest = Color3.fromRGB(79, 180, 255),
}
for _, option in ipairs({{"safe", "Safe ESP"}, {"bomb", "Bomb ESP"}, {"half", "50/50 ESP"}, {"suggest", "Show a guess when stuck"}}) do
    local key = option[1]
    tab:CreateToggle({name = option[2], value = settings[key], callback = function(value)
        settings[key] = value
    end})
end
tab:CreateSlider({

})
tab:CreateSlider({

})
tab:CreateToggle({name = "Auto-flag", value = settings.auto, forgetState = true, callback = function(value)
    settings.auto = value
end})
local status = tab:CreateText({name = "Board status", text = "Reading the board."})
tab:CreateButton({name = "Unload", callback = state.cleanup})

local function readTile(part)
    local gui = part:FindFirstChild("NumberGui")
    if not gui then
        return nil, part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model") ~= nil
    end
    local label = gui:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
    if not label or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then return nil, true end
    local value = label.Text
    if value == "X" then return nil, true end
    if value == "" then return 0, false end
    local clue = tonumber(value)
    if clue and clue >= 0 and clue <= 8 and clue % 1 == 0 then return clue, false end
    return nil, true
end

local function tileId(x, z)
    return tostring(x) .. "," .. tostring(z)
end

local function readBoard(parts)
    local tiles, occupied = {}, 0
    for _, part in ipairs(parts:GetChildren()) do
        if not part:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
        local x = math.round(part.Position.X / part.Size.X)
        local z = math.round(part.Position.Z / part.Size.Z)
        local number, flagged = readTile(part)
        tiles[tileId(x, z)] = {part = part, x = x, z = z, number = number, flagged = flagged}
        occupied += 1
    end
    return tiles, occupied
end

local cachedTiles, cachedCount, cachedParts, cachedMarks, cachedValid, cachedClueCount

local function solveBoard(parts, tiles, occupied)
    local unchanged = cachedParts == parts and cachedCount == occupied
    if unchanged then
        for id, tile in pairs(tiles) do
            local old = cachedTiles[id]
            if not old or old.part ~= tile.part or old.number ~= tile.number then
                unchanged = false
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if unchanged then return cachedMarks, cachedValid, cachedClueCount end

    local clues = {}
    for _, tile in pairs(tiles) do
        if tile.number == nil then continue end
        local ids = {}
        for dx = -1, 1 do
            for dz = -1, 1 do
                local id = tileId(tile.x + dx, tile.z + dz)
                local neighbor = tiles[id]
                if neighbor and neighbor.number == nil then table.insert(ids, id) end
            end
        end
        table.insert(clues, {ids = ids, count = tile.number})
    end
    local marks, valid = solve(clues)
    cachedParts, cachedTiles, cachedCount = parts, tiles, occupied
    cachedMarks, cachedValid, cachedClueCount = marks, valid, #clues
    return marks, valid, #clues
end

local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Events")
local flagEvents = events and events:FindFirstChild("FlagEvents")
local placeFlag = flagEvents and flagEvents:FindFirstChild("PlaceFlag")
local info = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Info")
local flagless = info and info:FindFirstChild("Flagless")
local requestArgument
local nextLookup = 0
local function getFlagArgument()
    if requestArgument then return requestArgument end
    if os.clock() < nextLookup then return nil end
    nextLookup = os.clock() + 5
    local closures = filtergc("function", {Constants = {"PlaceFlag"}, IgnoreExecutor = true}, false)
    for _, closure in ipairs(closures) do
        if not string.find(debug.info(closure, "s"), "ReplicatedFirst.MouseControl", 1, true) then continue end
        for _, value in pairs(debug.getupvalues(closure)) do
            if type(value) == "string" and value:match("^%d+$") then
                requestArgument = value
                return value
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local markers = {}
local route = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
route.Name = "NextTile"
route.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 28)
route.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0)
route.AlwaysOnTop = true
route.Enabled = false
route.Parent = overlay
local routeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
routeLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
routeLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 24, 29)
routeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
routeLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
routeLabel.TextSize = 13
routeLabel.Parent = route

local attempts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local pending

local function showMarker(tile, key, active)
    local part = tile.part
    local marker = markers[part]
    if not marker then
        marker = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        marker.Adornee = part
        marker.Size = Vector3.new(part.Size.X * 0.92, 0.08, part.Size.Z * 0.92)
        marker.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 0.08, 0)
        marker.ZIndex = 3
        marker.AlwaysOnTop = true
        marker.Parent = overlay
        markers[part] = marker
    end
    marker.Color3 = colors[key]
    marker.Transparency = if key == "safe" and tile.flagged then 0.18 else 0.38
    active[part] = true
end

local lastFlagAt = -math.huge
local function update()
    local board = workspace:FindFirstChild("Flag")
    local parts = board and board:FindFirstChild("Parts")
    if not parts then
        for _, marker in pairs(markers) do marker:Destroy() end
        table.clear(markers)
        route.Enabled = false
        status:Set("Waiting for the board.")
        return
    end
    local tiles, count = readBoard(parts)
    local marks, valid, clueCount = solveBoard(parts, tiles, count)
    local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local playing = player.Team ~= nil and player.Team == Teams:FindFirstChild("Playing")
    local eligible = playing and root and not (flagless and flagless:IsA("BoolValue") and flagless.Value)
    local now = os.clock()
    local counts = {safe = 0, bomb = 0, half = 0}
    local active = {}
    local candidate, bestDistance

    if pending then
        local _, flagged = readTile(pending.part)
        if pending.part.Parent == parts and flagged then
            state.flagsPlaced += 1
            pending = nil
        elseif pending.part.Parent ~= parts or now >= pending.deadline then
            pending = nil
        end
    end
    local openableSafe, flaggedSafe = 0, 0
    local guess, guessRisk, guessDistance
    local nearestSafe, safeDistance, nearestFlaggedSafe, flaggedSafeDistance
    local position = root and root.Position or (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)

    for id, tile in pairs(tiles) do
        if tile.number ~= nil then continue end
        local risk = marks[id]
        local key = if risk == 0 then "safe" elseif risk == 1 then "bomb" elseif risk == 0.5 then "half" else nil
        if key then counts[key] += 1 end
        if key == "safe" then
            local distance = position and (position - tile.part.Position).Magnitude
            if tile.flagged then
                flaggedSafe += 1
                if distance and (not flaggedSafeDistance or distance < flaggedSafeDistance) then
                    nearestFlaggedSafe, flaggedSafeDistance = tile, distance
                end
            else
                openableSafe += 1
                if distance and (not safeDistance or distance < safeDistance) then
                    nearestSafe, safeDistance = tile, distance
                end
            end
        end
        if key and settings[key] and (not tile.flagged or key == "safe") then
            showMarker(tile, key, active)
        end
        if tile.flagged or not position then continue end

        local distance = (position - tile.part.Position).Magnitude
        if key == "bomb" and eligible and not attempts[tile.part] then
            if distance <= settings.radius and (not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance) then
                candidate, bestDistance = tile.part, distance
            end
        elseif risk ~= 0 and risk ~= 1 and settings.suggest and valid and clueCount > 0 then
            local score = risk or math.huge
            local bestScore = guessRisk or math.huge
            if not guess or score < bestScore or (score == bestScore and distance < guessDistance) then
                guess, guessRisk, guessDistance = tile, risk, distance
            end
        end
    end

    local nextMove = ""
    local routeTile, routeText, routeColor
    if valid and count == 0 then
        nextMove = "\nWaiting for tiles."
    elseif valid and clueCount == 0 then
        nextMove = "\nOpen a tile to start solving."
    elseif valid and nearestSafe and settings.safe then
        routeTile, routeText, routeColor = nearestSafe, "SAFE", colors.safe
        nextMove = ("\nNearest safe tile: %.0f studs."):format(safeDistance)
    elseif valid and openableSafe == 0 then
        if flaggedSafe > 0 then
            if nearestFlaggedSafe and settings.safe then
                routeTile, routeText, routeColor = nearestFlaggedSafe, "UNFLAG", colors.safe
            end
            nextMove = ("\nUnflag a green tile (%d flagged)."):format(flaggedSafe)
        elseif guess then
            showMarker(guess, "suggest", active)
            routeTile, routeText, routeColor = guess, "GUESS", colors.suggest
            nextMove = if guessRisk then ("\nBlue guess: %.0f%% mine risk from connected clues."):format(guessRisk * 100)
                else "\nBlue guess: risk unknown."
        else
            nextMove = "\nNo proven safe move."
        end
    end
    route.Enabled = routeTile ~= nil
    route.Adornee = routeTile and routeTile.part or nil
    if routeTile then
        routeLabel.Text = routeText
        routeLabel.TextColor3 = routeColor
    end
    for part, marker in pairs(markers) do
        if not active[part] then
            marker:Destroy()
            markers[part] = nil
        end
    end

    local flagStatus = "Off"
    if settings.auto then
        if not eligible then
            flagStatus = "Waiting until you are playing"
        elseif not placeFlag or not placeFlag:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not getFlagArgument() then
            flagStatus = "Flag control unavailable"
        else
            flagStatus = ("%d placed | %d studs | %d ms"):format(state.flagsPlaced, settings.radius, settings.delayMs)
            if candidate and not pending and now - lastFlagAt >= settings.delayMs / 1000 then
                local number, flagged = readTile(candidate)
                if candidate.Parent == parts and number == nil and not flagged then
                    attempts[candidate] = true
                    lastFlagAt = now
                    pending = {part = candidate, deadline = now + 1.5}
                    placeFlag:FireServer(candidate, requestArgument, true)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    state.scans += 1
    state.last = {tiles = count, clues = clueCount, safe = counts.safe, bomb = counts.bomb,
        half = counts.half, flagControl = requestArgument ~= nil, eligible = not not eligible,
        nearest = bestDistance, valid = valid, flagsPlaced = state.flagsPlaced,
        flaggedSafe = flaggedSafe, openableSafe = openableSafe, suggested = guess ~= nil and openableSafe == 0 and flaggedSafe == 0}
    local message = ("%d safe  |  %d mines  |  %d at 50/50\nAuto-flag: %s%s"):format(
        counts.safe, counts.bomb, counts.half, flagStatus,
        if valid then nextMove else "\nWaiting for consistent clues")
    if status.text ~= message then status:Set(message) end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while state.alive and not window.unloaded do
        update()
        task.wait(if settings.auto then 0.05 else 0.4)
    end
    state.cleanup()
end)
return "bebebebe"
